name: @sorandomains/lookup
description: Resolve Soran names (alice.nova) on Stellar — trustlessly, straight from the chain.

scripts.check:browser: esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=browser --external:@stellar/stellar-sdk --outfile=browser-check.js --legal-comments=none --log-level=error && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('browser-check.js','utf8');fs.unlinkSync('browser-check.js');if(/\bBuffer\b/.test(s)){console.error('FAIL: bare Buffer reference in browser bundle');process.exit(1)}console.log('browser bundle clean')"
